summary: Bradford County, FL steel tower erected by the Florida Forest Service in 1939; last dated record is a 1942 repaint and towerman. No source found on its condition today.

facts.status_note: Last dated history is a 1942 repaint; no source read states its condition today

events.note: Florida Forest Service erected a 100-foot steel tower on land donated by W.H. Edwards, Jr.

Telegraph (May 1939, as quoted) said the tower would be named Louis Hill Tower and dedicated to the memory of a young Bradford County man, now deceased; caretaker's home complete, tower not yet manned
State Forestry Department repaired and painted tower and house; towerman Prescott named (Telegraph, July 1942, as quoted)

evidence.supports: agency is the Florida Forest Service
built 1939 as a 100-foot steel tower on donated land
evidence.quote: 1939: A 100-foot steel tower was erected by the Florida Forest Service on land donated for the purpose by W.H. Edwards, Jr.

evidence.supports: announced the tower would be dedicated to the memory of a Bradford County young man
evidence.quote: will be dedicated to the memory of a Bradford County young man, now deceased, who was outstanding in the forestry service.

evidence.supports: caretaker's home complete but not yet manned in 1939
evidence.quote: It is now complete, with caretaker's home already constructed, but has not yet been manned.

evidence.supports: 1942 repair and paint by the State Forestry Department
evidence.quote: The State Forestry Department has just finished repairing and painting the fire tower and house here.
Towerman Prescott is proud of the appearance of his grounds and new paint job.

evidence.supports: OpenStreetMap node is for Louis Hill Lookout Tower

corrections.why: The Forest Lookouts history for this tower is headed LOUIS HILL (highlands); the hill.html page holds only a bare HILL, Bradford County heading.
louis-hill.html holds the 1939 and 1942 history; hill.html has no history text.
No source read states the tower's condition after 1942, and the OpenStreetMap entry carries no status tag.

notes_for_editor: One detailed source (Forest Lookouts, quoting the Bradford County Telegraph for 1939 and 1942) plus an OSM point. The page's 100-foot height is used for height_m (30.5 m). The OSM ele value 64 is a map elevation, not tower height. Waymarking pages for this tower exist, but their text did not cache and were not cited. A WebFetch summary of one page mentioned a May 2023 visit log but no condition, so it is not used. Today's condition and access need a Florida Forest Service contact or a recent site report.
